How the reading informs these comparisons

For a policy view, record the horizon, the price before the event and the move in the announcement window. A steepening 2s10s can reflect a falling two-year yield, a rising ten-year yield, or both. Inspect the legs before interpreting the spread.

Looking at quantities alongside prices helps distinguish a demand contraction from an adverse supply shock. Annual growth and inflation can hide the order in which developments occurred. The monthly panel lets you check the sequence.

The instrument available to a central bank depends on its exchange-rate commitments and room for domestic adjustment. In the exchange-rate cases, follow the intervention and reserve evidence alongside the policy rate.
